name: KwikClick, Inc.
summary: KwikClick, Inc. (KWIK) develops and manages software platforms engineered to foster social interaction, drive sales, and facilitate referral programs. Its core offering, the KWIKClick platform, is specifically designed to amplify the promotion of various brands and services by leveraging a broad network of marketers, key opinion leaders, and existing clientele. The company further extends its business by offering licensing for its proprietary software solutions. KwikClick, Inc. was founded in 1990 and is based out of Bountiful, Utah.
